profile_text.body:
Meta is a public company founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, CA, USA, trading as META. Its developer site at llama.com presents products and solutions for AI developers. The site describes its model as tuned for long-horizon coding workflows, with fewer unnecessary turns and cleaner output, and says it performs competitively with frontier models across several coding evals. It states that a first working request can be made in under five minutes by pointing an existing OpenAI SDK compatible client at the Meta Model API, and that search grounding gives the model live web access by adding a single tool to a request.

Meta's AI product is Llama (Meta), an open-weight model family that is often self-hosted. Several MCP servers work with Meta Ads, including ai.adweave/meta-ads-mcp, which has 47 tools for campaigns, creatives, audiences, and insights, and co.pipeboard/meta-ads-mcp, which can analyze performance, test creatives, and optimize spend.

Meta reported revenue of $200,966,000,000 for the fiscal year ending 2025-12-31 on Form 10-K. Meta has 281 California law exposure entries. Litigation includes Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the District Court, W.D. Texas, Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. in the District Court, N.D. California, and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the U.S. District Court, N.D. California.
